Lakefront on Eastern Lake

Private pool (heating optional $55 a day)

Private fishing pier and swing bed

.5 of a mile from Walton Dunes Beach Access

Complimentary kayaks

4 adult bikes

Gourmet kitchen

5 bedrooms, 4 bathrooms

Parking for 4

Four Palms by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Welcome to Four Palms, a lakefront(!) retreat in Seagrove Beach with serious vacation personality. The backyard is the star of the show: a sparkling pool with a relaxing sitting spa, wide-open lake views, and a fishing pier with a swing bed: the unofficial nap headquarters. Dreamy! Professionally decorated, the vibes inside stay relaxed and polished. Five bedrooms and four bathrooms give everyone space to spread out, recharge, and pretend they’re staying forever. The kitchen is fully equipped, including a commercial ice maker that keeps the cold drinks flowing without a hiccup. Eastern Lake sits just steps away, calm and inviting.

Four kayaks are ready for sunrise paddles, quiet floats, or a scenic glide toward the Gulf. Feel like rolling instead of rowing? Hop on one of the four complimentary bikes and cruise through Seagrove, stopping anywhere that catches your eye. The Gulf beaches, standout restaurants, coastal markets, and charming little shops are all close, making each day a mix of easy relaxation and choose-your-own-fun. And for peace of mind, Oversee 30A is always nearby. Our local team is ready to help every day, with a 24/7 emergency line just in case something unexpected interrupts your perfect plan. Overview: -Seagrove Beach (Eastern Lakefront) -.5 of a mile from Walton Dunes Beach Access -Professionally decorated home -Wi-Fi -Private pool (can be heated seasonally for an additional $55.00 per day, contact Oversee for details) -Commercial ice maker -4 bikes and 4 kayaks -Parking for 4 Overnight: FIRST FLOOR Primary Room: King bed, private full bath, shower/tub Bunk Room: Twin-over-twin and twin-over-full, shared full bath, shower Living Room: Queen sleeper sofa SECOND FLOOR Primary Room: King bed, private full bath, shower Guest Room: King bed, shared full bath, shower/tub combo Guest Room: Two twins, shared full bath, shower/tub combo Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Check-out is 10:00 AM CST.
